# Roles and permissions

<!-- Generated by `pnpm docs:roles` from packages/shared/src/authorization/permission-catalogue.ts
     and the message catalogues; do not edit by hand (a unit test compares it). -->

What a person may do in a club comes only from **permissions** held through
**roles** (ADR 0046). A **club role** (administrator, registrar, treasurer, …)
applies in the whole club; a **group role** (in older text a *function*:
player, head coach, team manager, …) applies in its group. Each club starts
with the built-in template below and can change the roles' permissions and
create its own roles (named at least in the club's language and English).
A participant of a group is someone whose group role holds
`group.participate`; a leader one whose role holds `group.lead`.

Role keys that still decide something, on purpose: the locked
`club_manager` (the last administrator cannot leave or be removed, the
club's creator gets it, the invitation preset "administrator"; ADR 0018,
ADR 0046 A3) and the locked `chair` (recovering a club without
administrators). Everywhere else a role key is only a label
(`clubadmin/no-role-names`). The club page's administrator list is
[#25](https://github.com/SweRavn/ClubAdmin/issues/25).

## Permissions by area

Scope: where the permission applies. Sensitive: access to many people's
personal data, protected identity, money, history or roles (the roles page
warns before giving it).

### Members (Medlemmar)

| Permission | Scope | Sensitive | Svenska | English |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `club.guardians.manage` | club | yes | **Hantera vårdnadshavare**: Kan lägga till och bjuda in vårdnadshavare och anhöriga för medlemmar. | **Manage guardians**: Can add and invite guardians and relatives of members. |
| `club.guardianships.end` | club | yes | **Avsluta en förälders koppling**: Kan avsluta kopplingen mellan en förälder eller vårdnadshavare och ett barn i föreningen. | **End a parent's link**: Can end the link between a parent or legal guardian and a child in the club. |
| `club.invitations.manage` | club |  | **Bjuda in till föreningen**: Kan skicka och återkalla inbjudningar till föreningen. | **Invite to the club**: Can send and revoke invitations to the club. |
| `club.join_requests.manage` | club |  | **Hantera ansökningar**: Kan godkänna eller avslå ansökningar om medlemskap. | **Handle applications**: Can approve or decline applications for membership. |
| `club.members.add` | club |  | **Lägga till medlemmar**: Kan lägga in en ny medlem för hand. | **Add members**: Can add a new member by hand. |
| `club.members.export` | club | yes | **Exportera medlemsregistret**: Kan ladda ner medlemsregistret som en fil. | **Export the member register**: Can download the member register as a file. |
| `club.members.import` | club | yes | **Importera medlemmar**: Kan läsa in många medlemmar på en gång från en fil. | **Import members**: Can bring in many members at once from a file. |
| `club.members.manage` | club | yes | **Hantera medlemskap**: Kan pausa, återuppta, avsluta och ändra typ på medlemskap. | **Manage memberships**: Can pause, resume, end and change the type of memberships. |
| `club.members.read` | club | yes | **Se medlemsregistret**: Kan se listan över föreningens medlemmar med namn, medlemsnummer och grupper. | **See the member register**: Can see the list of the club's members with names, member numbers and groups. |
| `club.members.routine` | club | yes | **Sköta medlemskap löpande**: Behöver inte tvåstegsverifiering för varje ändring av medlemskap (för den som gör det dagligen). | **Handle memberships routinely**: Does not need two-step verification for each membership change (for those who do it daily). |
| `club.people.contact.edit` | club | yes | **Ändra medlemmarnas kontaktuppgifter**: Kan se och ändra medlemmarnas telefonnummer och adress, och se deras e-postadress. Kräver tvåfaktorinloggning. | **Change members' contact details**: Can see and change members' phone numbers and addresses, and see their email address. Requires two-factor login. |
| `club.people.details` | club | yes | **Se medlemmarnas uppgifter**: Kan se medlemmarnas kontaktuppgifter, födelsedatum och andra uppgifter i registret. | **See members' details**: Can see members' contact details, birth dates and other details in the register. |
| `club.waitlists.read` | club |  | **Se alla väntelistor**: Kan se föreningens alla väntelistor och vilka som står på dem. | **See every waiting list**: Can see all of the club's waiting lists and who is on them. |
| `group.people.details` | group | yes | **Se gruppmedlemmarnas uppgifter**: Kan se kontaktuppgifter till gruppens medlemmar och deras vårdnadshavare, även skyddade medlemmar i gruppen. | **See the group members' details**: Can see contact details of the group's members and their guardians, protected members of the group included. |
| `person.merge` | club | yes | **Slå ihop dubbletter**: Kan slå ihop två personer som registrerats två gånger. | **Merge duplicates**: Can merge two people who were registered twice. |
| `person.own_login.invite` | club |  | **Ge medlemmar egen inloggning**: Kan bjuda in en medlem att få en egen inloggning. | **Give members their own login**: Can invite a member to get their own login. |

| `group.participate` | group |  | **Delta i gruppens aktiviteter**: Får gruppens aktiviteter i sitt schema och ombeds svara om man kommer. | **Take part in the group's activities**: Gets the group's activities in their schedule and is asked whether they will come. |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `activity.history.read` | club | yes | **Se aktiviteters historik**: Kan se ändringar som gjorts i aktiviteter. | **See activities' history**: Can see changes made to activities. |

No certificates are kept, only that they were shown. |

Inget dokument eller kod sparas, och man bockar aldrig av sitt eget. | **Tick off shown background checks**: Can record that a person showed a valid check (type, dates, how). No document or code is kept, and nobody ticks off their own. |

| `club.people.protected` | club | yes | **Se personer med skyddad identitet**: Kan se vilka medlemmar som har skyddad identitet, som annars är dolda. | **See people with protected identity**: Can see which members have protected identity, who are otherwise hidden. |

| `group.history.read` | club | yes | **Se gruppers historik**: Kan se ändringar som gjorts i grupper. | **See groups' history**: Can see changes made to groups. |

| `person.history.read` | club | yes | **Se en medlems historik**: Kan se ändringar som gjorts i en medlems uppgifter. | **See a member's history**: Can see changes made to a member's details. |

### Documents (Dokument)

| Permission | Scope | Sensitive | Svenska | English |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `club.documents.manage` | club |  | **Hantera föreningens dokument**: Kan skapa mappar för hela föreningen, ladda upp filer och nya versioner, bestämma vem som ser dem och ta bort dem. Ser och hanterar också gruppernas dokument. | **Manage the club's documents**: Can create folders for the whole club, upload files and new versions, decide who sees them and delete them. Also sees and manages the groups' documents. |
| `club.governing_documents.adopt` | club | yes | **Registrera antagna styrdokument**: Kan registrera att ett utkast har antagits (datum, möte och när det gäller från). Versionen låses och de inställningar texten markerar blir föreningens beslut. Kräver inloggning med en andra faktor. | **Record governing documents as adopted**: Can record that a draft was adopted (date, meeting and when it applies from). The version is locked and the settings the text marks become the club's decision. Needs a login with a second factor. |
| `club.governing_documents.manage` | club |  | **Skriva föreningens styrdokument**: Kan skapa serier (stadgar, protokoll, policyer), skriva och ändra utkast till styrdokument i Markdown, markera de inställningar en text bestämmer, arkivera antagna dokument och ta bort utkast som aldrig antagits. | **Write the club's governing documents**: Can create series (statutes, minutes, policies), write and change drafts of governing documents in Markdown, mark the settings a text decides, archive adopted documents and delete drafts that were never adopted. |
| `group.documents.manage` | group |  | **Hantera gruppens dokument**: Kan skapa mappar i gruppen, ladda upp filer och nya versioner, bestämma vem som ser dem och ta bort dem. | **Manage the group's documents**: Can create folders in the group, upload files and new versions, decide who sees them and delete them. |
